cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Another customer complaint about me! I'm becoming the focus of this hotel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm taking you off reception while I investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Wonderful. Now management is organizing its day around me too.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll answer every complaint in writing from the laundry office.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My own correspondence operation, reaching into laundry. I'll need more paper.

mechanism: A corrects disciplinary restriction into expert-sounding signs of expanding influence, celebrating removal and complaint correspondence as new institutional reach.
confusable: D65 reframes loss as voluntarily granted; D68 treats imposed burdens as evidence influence is growing, without claiming A chose them.
comparison: Department alternative expands geographic remit through mobile files; hotel alternative converts investigation and laundry confinement into management attention and correspondence reach.
seedUse: Hotel complaints, removal from reception, investigation and laundry office derive from D68-b; S03 adds precise classification and routing instructions.
